summary: Equity Residential filed an 8-K disclosing pending all-stock merger-of-equals with AvalonBay Communities, structured as a merger with Canopy Merger Sub, a wholly owned subsidiary of Equity Residential. The combined company will operate as Vivmark Residential. The Form S-4 registration statement was declared effective July 13, 2026, and joint proxy statements were mailed. Shareholder litigation and demand letters allege disclosure deficiencies; both companies deny merit. Watch for court rulings on disclosure claims and shareholder votes; regulatory and shareholder approvals pending, with stock-for-stock exchange ratio and closing date not disclosed.
